name: A lead east from Darnassus · Warrior’s Terrace, Darnassus
interpretationNote: Original interpretive environment art for Warrior’s Terrace, Darnassus. Target reference: original pre-Cataclysm World of Warcraft Classic Warrior’s Terrace, Darnassus. Preserve recognizable traits: Original Darnassus identity: immense living tree forms, curving pale stone and timber walkways, elevated bridges, carved night-elf arches, muted ivory, lavender and cool teal accents. Not a screenshot, exact in-game map, surveyed route, mine floorplan or proof of character co-presence. Side-by-side comparison against the matching Classic area remains a human review gate.
